Score GetOrganelle candidate paths from real assembly output

Source: R/select_paths.R
score_assembly.Rd

Score GetOrganelle candidate paths from real assembly output

Usage

score_assembly(
  path_fastas,
  gfa_path = NA_character_,
  sample_lineage = NA_character_,
  sample_taxids = NA_character_,
  blast_db = NULL,
  taxdump_dir = NULL,
  with_staxids = FALSE,
  expected_length = c(4000, 12000),
  weights = DEFAULT_SCORE_WEIGHTS
)

Arguments

path_fastas

Per-path fasta files, each named with its path number last (<id>_assembly_<n>.fasta); n becomes the path column.

gfa_path

The assembly graph .gfa (for depth). May be NA.

sample_lineage

The sample's resolved rank-aligned lineage.

sample_taxids

The sample's rank-aligned lineage taxids. Preferred over the names when present: taxids carry no homonyms.

blast_db

BLAST nucleotide db prefix (e.g. the Actinopterygii seeds db, or an nt-style db).

taxdump_dir

Pinned taxdump dir (for resolving hit lineages).

with_staxids

TRUE if blast_db carries taxids; else taxonomy is taken from the seed-DB subject id species.

expected_length, weights

Passed to score_candidates().

Value

Scored candidate data.frame (see score_candidates()).
